C4 level 2: containers.</div>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=12;fontColor=#1F2933;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="28" width="270" height="100" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="zone-start" value="" style="rounded=1;arcSize=2;html=1;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 6;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#F1F8F1;strokeColor=#2E7D32;pointerEvents=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="500" y="270" width="340" height="960" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="zone-files" value="" style="rounded=1;arcSize=2;html=1;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 6;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#F6F7F9;strokeColor=#5B6770;pointerEvents=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="270" width="340" height="680" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="zone-balancer" value="" style="rounded=1;arcSize=2;html=1;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 6;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#F6F7F9;strokeColor=#5B6770;pointerEvents=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="980" y="270" width="780" height="330" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="zone-queue" value="" style="rounded=1;arcSize=2;html=1;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 6;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#F6F7F9;strokeColor=#5B6770;pointerEvents=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="980" y="880" width="780" height="630" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="zone-search" value="" style="rounded=1;arcSize=2;html=1;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 6;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#F6F7F9;strokeColor=#5B6770;pointerEvents=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="980" width="340" height="362" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="zone-start-caption" value="<b style="font-size:14px;color:#2E7D32">Start zone</b><br><b>What:</b> SPA, one API application and PostgreSQL.<br>The reminder queue lives in the same database.<br><b>Why:</b> run a deal from invoice to delivery<br>without losing a payment or a notification.<br><b>When:</b> from day one. A few deals per day." style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=12;fontColor=#1F2933;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="516" y="1096" width="308" height="107" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="zone-files-caption" value="<b style="font-size:14px;color:#5B6770">Growth zone: files and static content</b><br><b>What:</b> object storage with a CDN in front of<br>it.<br><b>Why:</b> invoice PDFs, deal documents and photos<br>are available to every instance; static files<br>load fast.<br><b>When:</b> a second instance appears, the disk is<br>over 70–80% full, or static files load slowly." style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=12;fontColor=#1F2933;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="56" y="786" width="308" height="139" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="zone-balancer-caption" value="<b style="font-size:14px;color:#5B6770">Growth zone: load balancer and instances</b><br><b>What:</b> a load balancer and more application instances.<br><b>Why:</b> the marketplace stays up when one instance fails or is being deployed; spare CPU.<br><b>When:</b> downtime on a failure or a deploy is no longer acceptable, or application CPU stays above<br>70–80% and p95 grows." style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=12;fontColor=#1F2933;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1110" y="478" width="630" height="91" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="zone-queue-caption" value="<b style="font-size:14px;color:#5B6770">Growth zone: Redis queue and workers</b><br><b>What:</b> a separate Redis for the BullMQ queue and workers in<br>their own process.<br><b>Why:</b> reminders and notifications stop sharing the database and<br>CPU with API requests.<br><b>When:</b> jobs wait in the queue longer than allowed, or the queue<br>puts visible load on the database." style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=12;fontColor=#1F2933;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1000" y="1372" width="420" height="123" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="zone-search-caption" value="<b style="font-size:14px;color:#5B6770">Growth zone: search</b><br><b>What:</b> an OpenSearch index.<br><b>Why:</b> catalog search with typo tolerance,<br>filters and ranking.<br><b>When:</b> that feature is needed, or search<br>queries become the slowest queries in the<br>database." At start it also<br>holds the BullMQ job queue.</div>"
